verdict.rationale: AngelList's conversions tooling generates an Excel-based pro forma with underlying formulas, explicitly intended for legal teams and prospective investors. It also records executed SAFE/note conversions on the cap table, which covers SAFE conversion, pro-forma output and sharing via export. Beyond that, the evidence is thin: there is no in-app scenario modeling, dilution calculator or option pool top-up, and the FAQ about transitioning customers to other cap table providers raises a continuity caveat. Missing for 10: interactive priced-round scenario modeling, option pool top-up modeling, explicit dilution analysis, in-platform scenario sharing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
